newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile December industrial output rises 5.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: Chile December industrial output rises 5.9 pct.

text.p: Chilean industrial production climbed 5.9 percent in December from the same month in 1995, while sales increased 12.8 percent, said the National Statistics Institute.

Industries which reported greatest increases in output in December included iron and steel, up 22 percent; publishing, up 17.5 percent; and oil refining production which rose 11 percent on the same month 1995.
Lower production was seen in industries including oil and coal, down six percent; clothing, down seven percent; and paper, which fell 0.7 percent.
